$purpose: The single authoritative source of truth for which Gemini models may be used for delegated work.
src/lib/model-floor.js reads this policy, src/lib/tool-registry.js enforces it at dispatch, and
the declaration-site drift check prevents independent model lists from contradicting it.

$purposesCannotLowerTheFloor: The configured model floor applies to every delegated purpose, including planning, review,
advisory, chat, and release review. A purpose never creates a lower-tier exception.
policy.$unknownIsRefusal: A model id absent from a backend's allowed list is refused, whether it is weaker, unknown, or unverified.

subscription.$identity: Configured subscription backend. Only the explicitly allowed high-capability model may be selected.

vertex.$identity: Configured Vertex backend. Only the explicitly allowed high-capability model may be selected.
vertex.$evidence: The allowed model is the verified high-capability tier for this backend. Requested and served model identities must match; substitution and fallback are refused.

notServable.gemini-2.5-flash: This model is not servable through the configured Vertex route without substitution. Substitution is refused.

vertex-seat.$identity: Configured Vertex seat backend. Only the explicitly allowed high-capability model may be selected.
vertex-seat.$evidence: The allowed model is runtime-verified for this route. Requested and served model identities must match; substitution and fallback are refused.

refusedIds.gemini-3.6-flash: Unknown and below the configured model floor. It is not an allowed model id on any configured backend.
refusedIds.gemini-2.5-flash: Below the configured model floor on every backend and not servable through the configured Vertex route without substitution.
refusedIds.gemini-3.1-flash-lite: Below the configured model floor. Silent model substitution is refused.
refusedIds.gemini-3-flash-preview: Below the configured model floor. Silent model substitution is refused.

declarationSites.note: Allowed and default lane models are derived from this policy for each backend.
Planning models are derived from each backend default, so purpose cannot lower the floor.
The provider model set and release-review default are derived from this policy.
The agentic model set and primary model are derived from this policy.
The high-capacity Vertex route derives its allowed and selected models from this policy and has no fallback.
The bounded Vertex route derives its selected model from this policy.
The Vertex seat route derives its selected and allowed model set from this policy and has no fallback.
This independent declaration remains tracked so drift is refused.
